name: Stop in Lika
overview: We pass through Lika every day and admire the view from the car, whether we are looking at the proud Velebit, Gacka dolina, Ličko polje or Zir. But, apart from mountaineers, adventurers, hunters and occasional travelers, few people stop in Lika. And to stop in Lika means to conquer the peaks of Velebit, cross the Premužić trail, sail the river Lika, hunt trout in Gacka, enjoy gastronomy, Lika plum brandy, ojkavica, bećarac, hospitality of the people, meet the faces of people and the beauty of nature that are becoming more interesting to foreigners.
